name: ATM Reject 2
definition: Information related to the reject of a message from an ATM or an ATM manager.

RejectInitiatorIdentification.name: Reject Initiator Identification
RejectInitiatorIdentification.definition: Identification of the entity sending the reject message.

RejectReason.name: Reject Reason
RejectReason.definition: High level information allowing the sender of a request or an advice to know the types of error, and handle them accordingly.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional information related to the sending of a reject message in response to a request or an advice.|For logging purpose, in order to allow further analysis, statistics and deferred processing on the success or the failure of the request processing.

Command.name: Command
Command.definition: Maintenance command to perform on the ATM.

MessageInError.name: Message In Error
MessageInError.definition: Received message that has been rejected.
